title: Blocked worker recovery through the gateway
description: Use a disposable gateway, run ledger, project, and slot to verify blocked-monitor refusals and a find-slot restart through run.replayStep. No operator runs or slots are used.

replay-gateway.intent: Send real run.replayStep requests to the isolated gateway and read back run.get and fleet.status to prove refusal leaves blocked state intact, while restart releases the old slot before reselecting.
